# SEO Hub Analyzer

An SEO analysis workspace that audits technical SEO, on-page structure, performance, and usability, then turns findings into prioritized fixes.

## About
Users simply enter a URL, and the platform analyzes key SEO factors like technical setup, on-page elements, performance metrics, and user experience. It then highlights issues, explains their impact, and provides step-by-step fixes.

The goal is not just to show problems, but to help users understand and fix them quickly.

## Public Endpoints
- / : Landing page and primary URL entry
- /about : About SEO Hub Analyzer
- /overview : Platform overview
- /capabilities : Detailed features and analysis capabilities
- /workflow : How the auditing workflow operates
- /pricing : Pricing plans
- /docs : Documentation and guides
- /api-reference : API details for developers
- /case-studies : Success stories
- /sample-report : Example of an SEO audit report
- /blog : Educational content on SEO
- /support : Support and help center
- /privacy : Privacy Policy
- /terms : Terms of Service

## Disallowed Endpoints
- /admin : Administrative dashboard
- /dashboard : User dashboard (requires authentication)
- /report : Dynamic SEO report content

For more information, please navigate through the site structure or consult the /docs page.
